text:
DUCKS ON THE POND CARDS INDEMNIFICATION POLICY

Version: 1.0 SAMPLE, November 2026

SAMPLE DOCUMENT. This policy is fictional. It was written as test content for the Ducks Corpus and has not been drafted or reviewed by a lawyer. It is not legal advice and is not in force. Do not rely on it or publish it as a real policy.

1. PURPOSE AND SCOPE

This Indemnification Policy explains who is responsible when a claim, loss or legal cost arises from the use of the Ducks on the Pond Cards application ("the Application"). It forms part of the Terms of Use and applies to every person who creates an account, adds catalog or collection data, lists cards, or takes part in trades through the Application ("you" or "Collector").

"Ducks on the Pond Cards", "we", "us" and "our" mean the operator of the Application, together with its owners, officers, employees, contractors and agents.

This policy should be read together with the Customer Service Policy (customer-service-policy.txt) and the User's Guide (users-guide.txt).

2. DEFINITIONS

Claim Any demand, complaint, lawsuit, arbitration, regulatory inquiry or other proceeding, whether threatened or actual.

Losses Damages, judgments, settlements, fines, penalties, costs and expenses, including reasonable attorneys' fees and court costs.

Collector A registered user of the Application, including test users in a test environment.

Collector Any information a Collector enters, including catalog entries, Content card copies, serial numbers, grades, cert numbers, prices, wishlist notes, trade messages and photos.

Trade An offer, counteroffer or completed exchange of cards between Collectors recorded in the Application.

3. NATURE OF THE SERVICE

The Application is a record-keeping and matching tool. In particular:

The Application is a record-keeping and matching tool. In particular:

a. We do not buy, sell, hold, ship, insure, authenticate or grade cards. b. We do not process payments. Paid prices, listed prices and sold prices are records entered by Collectors. c. Trades are agreements made directly between Collectors. Recording a trade as complete in the Application does not mean we have verified that any card was delivered or matched its description. d. Market prices shown in reports are for reference only and are not an appraisal, a guarantee of value, or an offer to buy. e. Serial-number conflict reviews are administrative decisions about records in the Application. They are not a legal finding of ownership or authenticity.

4. YOUR OBLIGATION TO INDEMNIFY US

You agree to defend, indemnify and hold harmless Ducks on the Pond Cards from and against any Claims and Losses arising out of or relating to:

a. Your use or misuse of the Application. b. Collector Content you submit, including any inaccurate, misleading or false description of a card's set, parallel, serial number, grade, cert number, condition or price. c. Any Trade or sale you take part in, including failure to deliver a card, delivery of a card that does not match its description, loss or damage in transit, and any dispute with another Collector. d. Any counterfeit, altered, stolen or misrepresented card you list, describe or trade. e. Your breach of the Terms of Use, the Customer Service Policy or this policy. f. Your violation of any law or regulation, including laws on consumer protection, taxes on sales, import and export, and fraud. g. Your infringement of another person's intellectual property, privacy or publicity rights, for example by uploading card photos or images you do not have the right to use. h. Access to the Application through your account by anyone you allowed to use it.

5. OUR OBLIGATION TO INDEMNIFY YOU

Ducks on the Pond Cards will defend and indemnify you against third-party Claims that the Application's software itself, as provided by us and used as intended, infringes a third party's copyright or trademark.

Ducks on the Pond Cards will defend and indemnify you against third-party Claims that the Application's software itself, as provided by us and used as intended, infringes a third party's copyright or trademark.

This obligation does not apply to Claims arising from Collector Content, Trades, or your combination of the Application with other software or data.

If such a Claim is made, we may, at our option: obtain the right for you to keep using the Application; modify it so it no longer infringes; or suspend the affected feature. This section states our entire liability for infringement Claims.

6. EXCLUSIONS

Neither party is required to indemnify the other for Losses to the extent they were caused by the other party's own fraud, gross negligence or wilful misconduct.

We are not responsible for:

a. The accuracy of catalog data added by Collectors. b. Any Collector's failure to honor a Trade. c. The value, condition, authenticity or grade of any card. d. Decisions made in serial-number conflict reviews, provided they were made in good faith on the information available. e. Loss of data in a test environment, which may be reset without notice. f. Interruptions caused by third-party hosting, database or network providers.

7. LIMITATION OF LIABILITY

To the fullest extent permitted by law:

a. We are not liable for indirect, incidental, special, consequential or punitive damages, including lost profits, lost trading opportunities or loss of collection value. b. Our total liability to you for all Claims relating to the Application in any 12-month period is limited to the greater of (i) the fees you paid us in that period, or (ii) one hundred U.S. dollars (US$100). The Application is currently free, so in most cases the limit is US$100.

Nothing in this policy limits liability that cannot be limited by law.

8. INDEMNIFICATION PROCEDURE

A party seeking indemnification ("the Indemnified Party") must:

A party seeking indemnification ("the Indemnified Party") must:

1. Give the other party ("the Indemnifying Party") written notice of the Claim within 30 days of learning about it. A late notice only reduces the obligation to the extent the delay causes harm. 2. Allow the Indemnifying Party to control the defense and settlement of the Claim, using counsel reasonably acceptable to the Indemnified Party. 3. Provide reasonable cooperation and information, at the Indemnifying Party's expense.

The Indemnifying Party may not settle a Claim in a way that admits fault on behalf of the Indemnified Party, or imposes obligations on it, without its written consent, which will not be unreasonably withheld.

The Indemnified Party may take part in the defense with its own counsel at its own expense.

Notices to us should be sent to: legal@ducksonthepondcards.com (fictional address for this sample).

9. DISPUTES BETWEEN COLLECTORS

Disputes between Collectors about Trades should first follow the trade dispute process in section 6.4 of the Customer Service Policy. We may help by reviewing records and correcting ownership data, but we are not a party to any Trade and do not act as an arbitrator, escrow agent or guarantor.

If you bring a Claim against us that arises from a dispute with another Collector, you release us from that Claim, except to the extent it results from our own fraud, gross negligence or wilful misconduct.

10. ACCOUNT ACTION

If a Claim against us arises from your conduct, we may restrict, suspend or close your account while the Claim is investigated, as described in section 9 of the Customer Service Policy. Doing so does not end your obligations under this policy.

11. SURVIVAL

Your obligations under this policy continue after your account is closed or deleted, for any Claim relating to activity that happened while the account was open.

12. GOVERNING LAW

This policy is governed by the laws of the State of [Fictional State], without regard to its conflict-of-law rules. Any proceeding relating to this policy will be brought in the courts located in [Fictional County].

This policy is governed by the laws of the State of [Fictional State], without regard to its conflict-of-law rules. Any proceeding relating to this policy will be brought in the courts located in [Fictional County].

13. SEVERABILITY AND CHANGES

If any part of this policy is found unenforceable, the rest remains in effect, and the unenforceable part is applied to the greatest extent permitted.

We may update this policy. Significant changes are announced in the Application at least 14 days before they take effect. Continuing to use the Application after that date means you accept the updated policy.

14. CONTACT

Questions about this policy: legal@ducksonthepondcards.com (fictional address for this sample).

END OF SAMPLE DOCUMENT
